creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Run's discovery loop calls t.Fatal on the first file that fails to parse, so
files sorted after it are never read. Two broken files means fix one, rerun,
discover the second - a round trip that is pure cost to a human and worse to an
agent, which pays a whole turn for it.

Suite.schema() already batches every schema problem into one message for exactly
this reason. The parse loop should match it: collect, then report all of them
with a count.

Read failures belong in the same batch - an unreadable file is the same class of
problem to whoever is fixing it.
title: One unparseable file hides every other parse error in the run
